# HiveVault

> Self-hosted memory of a company. Documents stay on the company server; local models compile them into linked Markdown pages with citations. A cloud agent reads the compiled pages classified "pubblico" or "interno" through an MCP server, with an API key.

## Connect

- MCP (streamable HTTP, stateless): POST /mcp with header `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`. Only API accounts; the administrator grants vaults and scopes.
- REST API for documents: /api/vaults, /api/vaults/{id}/sources (upload), /api/sources/{id} (status), /api/search, /api/pages/{id}.

## MCP tools

- brain_overview: vaults, page counts, coverage, recent pages. Call it first.
- brain_search: hybrid search with filters; ids, summaries, snippets with citations, cost in tokens.
- brain_read: a page or a document within a token budget; current state first.
- brain_neighbors: links and backlinks, up to 2 steps.
- brain_timeline: dated events of an entity, or of the vaults in a period.
- brain_source: extracted text of a citation ^[src_…#cN]. Original files never leave the server.
- brain_ask: short answer by the local model, with citations.
- brain_capture: save a note in the inbox of a writable vault (scope write).
- brain_journal: the work journal. "leggi" reads the latest session and day notes; "sessione" and "giornata" write a note (Fatto, Deciso, Aperto) in the inbox, linked to existing pages (scope write).
- brain_propose_edit: propose a change; a person approves it (scope write).

## Resources and prompts

- brain://{vault}/index, brain://{vault}/llms.txt, brain://{vault}/page/{id}
- Prompts: cosa-sappiamo-di, stato-cliente, prepara-riunione

## Rules

- Cite every fact with the id the tools return.
- Pages classified "riservato" and "segreto" are never returned to API accounts.
- A missing answer means "not in the memory or not visible to this account".
